methodology: Named callbacks from the archived98-ability registry (59READ), lexical static function/call graph over MMC services and dependent MDG/V4/school/source code; manual verification of candidates, dynamic Reflection V4 dispatch and native read dependencies. PHP strings/comments are masked; SQL/API write methods reviewed in their actual conditional call paths. Not a proof for every third-party hook or every runtime data state.
scope_notes: #115 moves program-integrity from SIDE_EFFECT_DOMAIN to SIDE_EFFECT_TECHNICAL because Kommo pipeline/lead/token transients may still warm.
Technical classification marks a reachable cache path, including warm-cache calls that perform no write.
Three operations abilities have confirmed conditional domain writes; existing initialized fixtures may produce no live write. They are not fixed in this PR.
WordPress request bootstrap, background cron/concurrent jobs and arbitrary third-party hooks are outside the guarded callback boundary; separate before/after hashes cover all13 Kommo profiles.

Separate admin GET paths (Kommo render ensure_profile, finance snapshots, active-program user preference) and public source option caching from prior audit are outside the59 ability list and unchanged. Do not infer every admin GET is now pure.
Kommo dynamic-source refresh warning is a separate freshness finding; no architecture change.
